# Leadership

<p class="sx-lede">Representing students, and organising a finance event for them.</p>

I am a school prefect at Sri Kumaran's Children's Home School for 2026–27. In July 2026 I was an organiser of Kumaran's Vyapar finance event, and designed and ran the simulation rounds for its Gambit event.
:::

:::

::: {.sx-section}
<p class="sx-label">Vyapar · July 2026</p>

## A finance event where students make the decisions

Kumaran's Vyapar is my school's finance event. For its Gambit event I designed and ran simulation rounds that asked participants to act the way people in finance do:

<ol class="sx-flow" aria-label="The Gambit rounds">
<li><b>Attract companies as VCs</b><span>Make the case that a company should take your investment</span></li>
<li><b>Trade on the news</b><span>Decide what to buy and sell as market news arrives</span></li>
<li><b>Resolve a company crisis</b><span>Work through a case study and decide what the company should do</span></li>
</ol>

<p class="sx-label">School prefect · 2026 – 2027</p>

## Representing the student body

As a prefect I represent students on the student council, help maintain discipline, and coordinate literary festivals, school events and student activities.
